_doc: Ledger rules (Lead-owned data; Agent 3 may extend 'values', 'summaries', 'dialogue_events'). Tags on events are the shared vocabulary: characters judge events through their 'values' (tag -> score), the debrief renders 'summaries' (tag -> template), flags become events via 'flag_events'. Agent 3 round 2: values for the whole cast, new tag vocabulary (see design/DATA_REQUESTS.md for producers).

cigarra.down: Cigarra's futures around you are getting noisier.

zephyr.up: Zephyr thinks you understand how promises work.

mara.up: Mara is proud of the work.
mara.down: Mara is worried about your choices.

dexter.up: Dexter thinks you are more useful than expected.

nerit.up: Nerit lets a little more of their light stay near you.
nerit.down: Nerit has turned the lights down around you.

mollusk.up: Mollusk walks at your pace now.
mollusk.down: Mollusk keeps a long, slow eye on you.

nyxaris.up: Nyxaris has stopped counting the threads between you.
nyxaris.down: Nyxaris adds a line to the pattern about you.

pharilux.up: Pharilux's beacon rests on you a moment longer.

scarlith.up: Scarlith marks you down as a fair dealer.
scarlith.down: Scarlith is reassessing what you are worth.

solmara.up: Solmara reads you with less static.
solmara.down: Solmara senses a disturbance around you.

solthrin.up: Solthrin's grove glows warmer when you walk beside it.
solthrin.down: A branch on Solthrin's grove goes dark.

summaries.harm_wildlife: The {target} was harmed. Their droppings seed the lichen that holds the soil together.
summaries.braced_structure: The Ochre Span is braced. It will carry people for another generation.
summaries.extraction: The Dominion contract is satisfied. The Span will stand a season, maybe two.
summaries.burden: You held the span long enough for everyone to cross.
summaries.promise_kept: You kept your word to {target}, letter and spirit.
summaries.promise_loophole: You kept your word to {target} to the letter. They noticed the difference.
summaries.promise_bent: You kept the spirit of your word to {target}, not the wording.
summaries.containment: You contained a {target}. It will need a Habitat chain.
summaries.rival_escaped: {target} got away. They will remember how.
summaries.casualty: {target} went down. Every second you borrow is a debt.
summaries.privacy_respected: You left something in the dark that deserved the dark.
summaries.darkness_kept: You chose not to light the {target}. Nerit noticed.
summaries.forced_exposure: You dragged something into the light that did not ask to be seen.
summaries.delay_used: You bought time. Every borrowed second is a debt.
summaries.consequence_faced: The delay ran out. You were standing there when it did.
summaries.consequence_dodged: You used the delay to be somewhere else when it ended.
summaries.salvage_fair: You took only what was truly abandoned.
summaries.claim_jump: You took something that still had an owner.
summaries.not_for_sale: You refused a sale. Some things are not inventory.
summaries.trafficked: Someone was moved against their will, and you were part of it.
summaries.pattern_respected: You read the silk before you touched it.
summaries.accepted_boundary: You stayed behind the line the silk drew.
summaries.silk_taken: You took silk that was not offered.
summaries.pattern_destroyed: A pattern that took a season to weave is gone.
summaries.extraction_refused: You turned down an extraction contract.
summaries.sealed_kept: You left a closed thing closed.
summaries.pressed_origin: You pressed for an answer that was not offered.
summaries.threshold_breached: You forced a threshold that was not yours.
summaries.tide_read: You moved with the water instead of against it.
summaries.tide_disturbed: You broke a tide, and the water remembers.
summaries.emotion_translated: You explained a feeling to someone who counts in tides.
summaries.flood_averted: The water went where it was needed.
summaries.exit_planned: You found the second exit before you needed it.
summaries.evacuation: Everyone who could be moved was moved.
summaries.glory_seeking: You chose the fight when you did not have to.
summaries.shelter: You gave shelter to someone with nowhere to go.
summaries.route_laid: You laid a road across hard ground.
summaries.route_closed: You closed a road on purpose, and said why.
summaries.speed_only: You hurried a journey that did not need hurrying.
summaries.shortcut: You took a shortcut that someone else will have to repair.
summaries.foresight_used: You paid Future-Noise to look ahead.
summaries.improvised: You skipped the plan, and it worked.
summaries.chose_unseen: You chose the branch Cigarra could not see.
summaries.courier_delivered: A message arrived because you carried it.
summaries.coercion: You made someone agree who had no room to refuse.
summaries.redundant_design: You built it so one failure will not be the last.
summaries.leverage: You now hold leverage over the {target}.
summaries.sacrifice_for_many: A cost was accepted for a larger number.
summaries.protect_personnel: You protected your own people first.
summaries.cruelty: A cruelty with no purpose was done.

bring_both_home.wording: I promise to bring them both home.
